title: Printable symmetry grid
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 2: Statistics; position and direction; shape; assessment
source: Seeded from mathematics/y2 lesson 77 (Printable symmetry grid)
intro: Lesson 77: Lines of symmetry. To understand how to find a vertical line of symmetry

blocks.text: Draw a line of symmetry down the middle. Draw half a shape on one side and complete it on the other.

questions.q: Does a rectangle have a vertical line of symmetry?
questions.model: Teacher folds a paper rectangle in half: the halves match.

questions.q: Tick the shapes on the sheet with a vertical line of symmetry.
Finish the half-drawn shapes on the grid.
Which capital letters from A to H have a vertical line?
Big question: how can we check?
questions.a: Fold on the line: if the halves match, it is symmetrical.
